steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Grab your stuff! It's over at the slums!

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: It's too late... If only we caught wind of this earlier in the day. Let's see if there's anything we can still do. Prep your medical equipment. We'll set up shop here—

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: —Not here. We still have no idea what exactly happened. Let's not draw too much attention, just to be safe.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: You're right... Bring out the medical tent. Not a lot of people go to the woods behind the hills. Set it up there. We'll head over to the slums!

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Over here!

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Boy. Boy! Wake up. Can you hear us?

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: I don't see any Originium crystals on his body. Hard to say if he's infected or not... He's holding onto something... A staff? A kid like him?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Quick, bring him with us!

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: We're back! Got a kid with us.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Good work. Now leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We couldn't tell whether he's infected, but he won't let go of this staff, so he probably knows some Arts. Anything else you need us to do?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You two just get some rest. I'll give him a checkup. A few guys stayed behind at the office to listen for news. All you have to do is make sure no one finds us here.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Alright! I'll fix you guys a midnight snack to fill your stomachs. The kid doesn't look like he's had much to eat, either. I'll make some porridge.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, I'll take him inside then.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: He must still be in his teens... *Sigh*... You're just a kid, but you've already had to go through all that.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There are no obvious signs of Oripathy on the surface, but... the tests show he's infected.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: His injuries aren't too serious, but with his weak body... Let's speed things up with some Arts.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We still have some suppressants left, and we already gave him a sedative.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (The power generator's too loud. We're done with the checkups, so I guess we won't need this equipment for now. The lights will just make it harder to sleep.)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (So I'll turn them off along with the generator. The least I can do is let him get a good night's rest.)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (I'll also set a timer to check up on him in two hours.)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: *Sigh*...
Inside the dark tent, a tiny body is curled up on the bed.
The pain from his fever and exhaustion is canceling out the sedative effects of the medicine. He dreams a restless dream, where he is suddenly trying to find something.
Perhaps he seeks the embrace of his parents, or the warmth of his home.
But all those happy things had left him the day before. Even though he's not fully aware of it right now, his loss is no less painful in the dream.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *Cough*...!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Oh... It's dark...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: There's no one here... Mm...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *Whimpers*... It's pitch black. Is the electricity out here too?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Eep... What's that next to me? An IV drip? Was I saved after Mamá got me out?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Is there anything else here... Oh, I still have my staff with me.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Right, two men found me. They must've brought me here. I've gotta thank them.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I should get out of bed and take a look around... Phew... Ah... Just sitting up is so tiring...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *Sobs*... There's no one here... I'm all alone.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: But how come Mamá didn't say anything and just told me to run?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Will I... get to see Papá and Mamá again? *Sobs*...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: This place is so dark, and there's no one around... Did something happen to them? I... I know how to use Arts. Mamá taught me how.
The frail boy lies on his bed and reaches a hand out to the staff by his bedside.
He was the one who put this staff together, piece by piece, from broken parts and abandoned ore, until the moment a light shone from his hands.
'Light.' He kept thinking about that word. He wanted to shine a light to help those who helped him.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: The glass lampshade is still in one piece. These gears and screws are all in great shape, too, but were thrown away just because the machine broke. What a shame.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: But now I have all the parts! I just have to connect this wire to the main board, then connect it here... Maybe I should try casting some Arts?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Whoa! That gave me an electric shock! It hurts... Maybe this isn't as easy as I thought.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Papá and Mamá still aren't home yet. I can't wait to see their faces if I manage to get it fixed before they get back!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: And after I find a good job, I'll buy Mamá lots of medicine, and once she gets better, Papá won't have to work at the factory anymore.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Hmm... It takes so much force to turn these screws... Papá must be really strong. He does everything so fast.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Yeah! I'll finish this before they get home!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Mamá, look! I can use the Arts you taught me with this staff!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Hup—Look, it lit up! I built this staff all by myself, too!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I remember everything you taught me. I wrote it all down in my notes too. Increase the voltage—Hup! Look!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I'm a fast learner, right? I'll become the best Caster around. We'll have an endless supply of electricity, enough to keep the lights on all day!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Mamá, wait. They said we'll get sick if we go outside. You can't—

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Papá's factory? He's not back yet. Where is he?!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I'll come with you, Mamá. Let me come. I know how to use Arts. I can—

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Mamá!

In his endless dreams, he bravely broke open the door his mother had locked, and powerfully sifted through all the shining debris at the factory. The scary disease the adults spoke of had no effect on him.

He used his mother's Arts to illuminate the sky. Under his light, the rescuers pulled unconscious workers out from the rubble one after another. His father had only minor injuries, and immediately joined the rescue team.
Then, after they got home, they moved far away, to a place without dust in the air.
He learned even more Arts, and lived a happy life with both his parents.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Eep—There we go...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Hmm—

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: It's not much... Just a tiny light.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: But it's more than enough. If I can light the path beneath my feet, I can help others...!
The ice-cold air rushes into his nostrils. The frail Perro boy has always wanted to turn his dreams into reality.
In front of the factory's rubble, he saw his mother casting Arts on such a large scale for the first time. Her radiance illuminated the night and shone upon every corner of the area.
He, too, wants to help others with his light.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Eep, it's so cold—

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: What a big tent. There's no one else around, though. Where... Where did they all go?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Papá said that we should lend others a helping hand whenever we can, and only then will our lives get better...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: It's so dark though... Did something really happen here? I... I gotta go—

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *Whimper*... My whole body's sore... Where is this place?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: The woods? T-The ones behind the mountains? That's so far away... Mamá told me it's dangerous here, because people rarely come.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: It's already so late, and they don't have any lights. They must need my help. I... I need to be like Mamá, and help those in need!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I need to head outside and find them...! I-I'll help them!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: *Cough*... How long have I been walking...? Why isn't there anyone here?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Ugh, my head hurts.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: No, I need to hang in there. I need to be a man of my word. I need to be strong. I...
Two hours later

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (It's 3:50. Let me check on him.)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: ...! Why is the tent open?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Where did he go?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh no. I knew two hours was too long!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Quick, the boy we rescued is gone! Hurry and check the area—!

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: He's not here—

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Not here either—

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Look over there! Why is it glowing there?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: —Oh, he's here! I found him!
The next morning...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Hmm... Is it morning already?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Phew—You're finally awake.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Here, have some water.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: I'll warm up some porridge for you. We made it last night. No need to chew, just swallow it. It's not going to upset your stomach.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Oh, uh, g-gracias!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: L-Last night, did I—?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: About that... I'm sorry. I shouldn't have left you alone in there.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: N-Not at all! It's my fault for trying to go outside. I thought it was too dark, so—

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Porridge's here!

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: What were you two talking about? You can chat later, but you should fill yourself up first. You haven't had anything to eat the whole time, and Rita said she's gonna need to do another checkup on you afterwards.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: I'm back! Is the kid awake? Come on, let's sit you up. You must be exhausted, after running around in the dark like that. Rita, why don't you take care of your other work? The two of us can look after him.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, I appreciate it.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Everything looks good. You're just a little malnourished. Your Oripathy is looking pretty mild so far too, but we'll need to take you somewhere with more professional equipment to run more thorough tests.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Don't worry, kid! We won't just abandon someone we saved partway through. Just relax and focus on getting better.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: We also have something to tell you.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Right, we're backline workers for a medical company called Rhodes Island. This is just a temporary medical tent we've set up.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We talked this over last night, but given the circumstances... Sorry, we can't ensure your safety for too long.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: D-Do you know what happened near your home?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Mamá sent me outside and told me to run as far as I could, then... she went back...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: A few days ago, Papá said he was going to the factories to look for a new job, and he hasn't been back since.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: After that... I'm not too sure what happened.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Then... Do you know that you're sick?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I do... They told me before that you get rocks on your body when you catch this disease. A lot of people have it where I live.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Then... What about your parents? Are they both Infected?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Sí... There was an accident at the factory...

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: They got people Infected, then drove them into a corner. Those pendejos!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hey, not in front of the kid!

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: My bad... I know I shouldn't get worked up, but I mean, it's just too...

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Hurry up and tell him. Just listening to this is pissing me off.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: So we were talking last night, and we're thinking about introducing you to our company. You know, see if you're interested, or if you want to go.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We have some medical equipment here, but it's leaps and bounds better on Rhodes Island. Besides, you know some electrical Arts, don't you?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We have plenty of amazing folks there who know a ton of awesome Arts. You could learn a lot from them.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Even more awesome Arts?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: Yep, that's right. By the way, who taught you yours?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I learned them from mi mamá...

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Sorry, kid, I didn't mean to swear. We're sorry about you and your parents. We'll... keep looking for them.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Y-You don't have to apologize!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Thank you so much for saving me, and... I also want to do something to return the favor.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I-I know a little electrical Arts. I woke up in the middle of the night last night, and it was so dark. There wasn't any light at all...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: So you have no electricity here, right? Just like where I'm from? I... I was going to give you guys some electricity... to return the favor...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I saw how dark it was here. Did something happen to this place, too? But I... I passed out after a while, and when I woke up, I was back on this bed.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: This is my staff. I was too tired last night, so it wasn't very bright, but... I can usually light up my whole house!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: So you came outside to light up our base?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: When I use the Arts mi mamá taught me, I can make my staff glow for a really long time!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Was I any help?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: (So that's why he...)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes! You absolutely helped us.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: These two guys were lost last night, and you know how dark it was outside. It was thanks to your staff's light that they made it back.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: They were going to thank you, but forgot because of all the work we had this morning. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: ...Yeah! Totally slipped my mind!

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: We were going to sleep it rough last night, but then we saw a faint light, which led us to you. We wouldn't have found our way without it!

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: (Winks)

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: (Gets the idea)

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: That's right! Your light was real bright last night! Thanks, kid!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Then... I'll go! I'll get even better, and I'll learn even more awesome Arts, lots of them, then I'll come back to help you guys!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I know me being here isn't very helpful, but... I don't know where my parents are either, and I need you guys to help me find them...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: I'll come back once I get better! I'll be back to light up the whole night sky!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, then we'll wait for you here. It's a promise. You gotta learn lots of useful Arts to help us out.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right, what's your name anyway? We still don't know what to call you.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: Just so you know, we all have codenames here, but we've all known each other for a long time, so we just call each other by our real names.

steps.name: Office Operator A
steps.text: I'm Fernando, this is Pedro, and she's Rita.

steps.name: Office Operator B
steps.text: But now that you're going to the landship, you should pick a codename for yourself. Pick whatever you like.

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Frail Perro Boy
steps.text: C-Call me Greyy!
